description: Reconcile physical storage reports and retained pagination across a backend restart.
preconditions: State and read-only Distribution inspection are configured for this isolated release.
assertions: A completed report is required; unavailable accounting is a failure.
Object and category totals agree for each observed domain, including the uploaded manifest, config and layer.
Registry totals match an independent filesystem metadata scan.
Retained reports remain immutable across restart.

checks.description: Enumerate both domains and reconcile every observed physical object and category.
Read the same immutable report after a backend restart.

outputs: Snapshot identity, domain totals, enumerated objects, usage groups and restart evidence.
